## Activity

The activity record for Market Eye Clinic covers March 2019. During this period, the clinic completed 415 captures. This provides the overall count of images submitted for review during the reporting month. The activity level is presented as recorded, without adjustment or extrapolation. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. This note provides context for interpreting the reported activity and should be read alongside the image-quality and grading results.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.1. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The count and rate are reported together to provide a clear view of image quality during March 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 62 referable results. These results represent the number recorded as referable within the reporting period. The median lag from capture to grading was 7 days. This is the midpoint of the recorded interval between the image being obtained and the grading outcome being available. Taken together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures summarise operations at Market Eye Clinic for March 2019.
